tool_args.rationale: The epidemic mobility bridge points to the inland-hub siphon, but five observations at one sink gradient cannot identify its gradient dependence or reliably distinguish its open branch. The targeted probe addresses that ambiguity at lower cost than a trajectory batch.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the inland-hub siphon bridge immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All pilot rows have s_grad = 1, so the sink inhibition and branch contributions are not independently identifiable.

considered_alternatives.option: Cooperative Hill inhibition or barrier-modulated siphon
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The fixed-gradient pilot does not distinguish these from the bridged siphon; the open-branch probe varies the relevant conditions.
The mobility-bridge and flux-conservation signatures favor the static siphon family; trajectory measurements are more costly and not yet warranted.
It does not resolve the relevant mechanism ambiguity.
